title: Origins Sylvenn
description: The official Sylvenn Origin from the Lornwood Smp
body:
# The Sylvenn Origin 

## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Required Mods 

[Extra Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/extra-origins) (for the Thumb Ability)


Reminder this Origin is not the same as in the Lornwood SMP this Origin has been cleaned up for public use so some things might be tweaked a bit.


### Origin Info

For a cleaner view check the Gallery  

## Lore

This Origin thrives best in forests or plains, as a swift and nimble prey creature. They are traditionally found tending to the flora and fauna of the land they occupy, encouraging the wildlife to thrive as a part of their traditional culture.

## Powers

### Bounding legs
Charge forward to escape or engage a foe. Additionally, take half as much fall damage.

### Feral instincts
When you're badly wounded, gain a burst of speed to flee your enemies.

### Grazing factor
You are a creature meant to consume a lot of food. You get hungry faster.

### Green Thumb
Years of skilled cultivation has granted your people the ability to sense the nature plants to some degree. You can manipulate them to grow quickly with your touch.

### Fragile bones
You have less hearts than others.

### Big Horns / Ears
Due to your big Horns or Ears you cannot equip solid helmets anymore

### Hunted
Arrows are the marksman's weapon, they find easy purchase in your body. They are more effective against you.

### Herbivore
Cannot eat Meat based foods

### Nocturnal
You can see clearly at night.
